title: JLPT N4 Vocabulary — Daily Life
description: Common N4 nouns, verbs, and する-nouns for everyday situations.

questions.question: 「約束」の意味は何ですか？
questions.explanation: 約束 (やくそく) = a promise or arrangement to meet.

questions.question: 「準備」の意味は何ですか？
questions.explanation: 準備 (じゅんび) = preparation. 準備をする = to get ready.

questions.question: 「説明」の意味は何ですか？
questions.explanation: 説明 (せつめい) = explanation. 説明書 (せつめいしょ) = manual.

questions.question: 「予約」の意味は何ですか？
questions.explanation: 予約 (よやく) = reservation / booking (hotel, restaurant, tickets).

questions.question: 「心配」の意味は何ですか？
questions.explanation: 心配 (しんぱい) = worry, anxiety. 心配しないで = don't worry.

questions.question: 「予定」の意味は何ですか？
questions.explanation: 予定 (よてい) = plan, schedule. 明日の予定 = tomorrow's plans.

questions.question: 「都合」の意味は何ですか？
questions.explanation: 都合 (つごう) = convenience, circumstances. 都合が悪い = inconvenient.

questions.question: 「世話」の意味は何ですか？
questions.explanation: 世話 (せわ) = care. 世話になる = to be looked after; お世話様です.

questions.question: 「遅刻」の意味は何ですか？
questions.explanation: 遅刻 (ちこく) = being late. 電車が遅刻した is wrong — 遅刻する is for people.

questions.question: 「集まる」の意味は何ですか？
questions.explanation: 集まる (あつまる) = to gather, to assemble. 集める (あつめる) = to collect (something).

questions.question: 「預ける」の意味は何ですか？
options: To deposit / leave in someone's care
questions.explanation: 預ける (あずける) = to deposit, entrust. 預かる (あずかる) = to take care of.

questions.question: 「片付ける」の意味は何ですか？
questions.explanation: 片付ける (かたづける) = to tidy up, put in order. 部屋を片付ける = tidy one's room.

questions.question: 「貸す」の意味は何ですか？
questions.explanation: 貸す (かす) = to lend. 借りる (かりる) = to borrow.

questions.question: Translate 送る into English.
questions.explanation: 送る (おくる) = to send (a letter, parcel, person).

questions.question: Translate 借りる into English.
questions.explanation: 借りる (かりる) = to borrow, to rent. 図書館で本を借りる = borrow a book at the library.

questions.question: Translate 手伝う into English.
questions.explanation: 手伝う (てつだう) = to help, to assist. 手伝ってくれますか = could you help me?

questions.question: Translate 経験 into English.
questions.hint: An English noun about things you have done
questions.explanation: 経験 (けいけん) = experience. 日本語を教えた経験があります = I have experience teaching Japanese.

questions.question: Translate 意味 into English.
questions.explanation: 意味 (いみ) = meaning. この言葉の意味は何ですか = what does this word mean?

questions.question: 「案内」の意味は何ですか？
questions.explanation: 案内 (あんない) = guidance, information. 案内書 (あんないしょ) = guidebook.

questions.question: 「使い方」の意味は何ですか？
questions.explanation: 使い方 (つかいかた) = way of using, how to use. 〜方 (かた) turns a verb into "way of …ing".
